# Monkey AIsland

> A repeatable benchmark measuring the capability of generative AI systems in the domain of game creation, anchored to a fixed creative brief: recreate The Secret of Monkey Island (1990). Authored by Jamie Skella.

Monkey AIsland is a longitudinal study. Each generation re-runs the same brief against the current frontier of generative tools and scores the result across a fixed rubric (visual fidelity, audio fidelity, narrative cohesion, code quality, gameplay loop, scope realised, time to first playable, total cost). Version 1 ran in March 2026; subsequent generations follow as the underlying tools advance.

## Project

- [Homepage](https://monkeyaisland.com/): Project overview, methodology, current generation scorecard, and roadmap.
- [Version 1, March 2026](https://monkeyaisland.com/v1-2026/): Playable build, walkthrough, and progress notes from the first generation.
- [Gameplay video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sbsg-N7dzOI): Short capture of the v1 playable.
